findings: Retain as diagnostic proposal and adverse theory example; reject source-stated generic certification and empirical-superiority adoption.
No guarantee of causal truth follows from output stability, entropy or self-risk.
Census disposition can close primary inspection after connected integration; wider census and visual acceptance remain open.
Valid narrow zero-one self-risk TV bound is derived; no entropy subtraction or truth certificate.
All prior census rows preserved; only261 moves from unread to inspected.
limitations: Author mathematical and primary-text review, not independent review or native empirical reproduction.
No downloaded code/model, new image preview or live evaluation executed.
The proposed score may remain a heuristic; supplied counterexamples reject general stated guarantees, not every restricted future variant.
Reported tables are source claims with unresolved experiment identity, not verified measurements or bank return.
Semantic perturbation, truth and causal identification require separate evidence.
